property_summary: For any external actor, airDrop only mints tokens when the actor's supportsToken returns the expected Nu Token hash, so tokenBalance(actor) remains 0 for any ordinary (non-Bank) caller; the mutant removes that check and lets any actor receive 20 tokens.
change_summary: Remove the supportsToken check so callers other than the Bank contract (any msg.sender) can successfully call airDrop and receive 20 tokens where the original reverts.
